headline: Nine Vicious calls out those who tried to ban him from Atlanta during his sold-out Seditio
body: Nine Vicious calls out those who tried to ban him from Atlanta during his sold-out Sedition Tour stop in ATL. “Everybody tried to stop me, you try to ban me, you can’t do that. You’re not good enough. Work harder, get better… I want smoke with y’all, so stop f**king talking to me,” Nine said.
